plan.title: Oak Bowl: Finished to Start
plan.summary: Opens with the finished oiled oak bowl, then traces its making from raw blank through lathe turning, sanding, and oil finish in source order.

analysis_notes: Meta director selected the moments; scene cuts, speech bands and transcript come from local analysis.

review.verdict: Structure is correct but cut reads as title cards over flat color, not a bowl story. No finished bowl or process is actually seen, and the cropped opening kills the hook. Replace cards with real footage and fix titles to serve the 20-second reveal-then-make goal.
review.caption_suggestion: Finished bowl first, then how it happens: raw oak to turning to sanding to oil.
strengths: Follows approved story order: finished reveal then raw, turning, sanding, oil finish.
Even chapter pacing across 18.0s suits vertical short attention span.
Numbered lower-thirds plus subtitles keep steps clear even without sound.
Closes on oil finish, giving a complete making arc.

fixes.what: 0.0-3.0s opening hook shows flat tan card and cropped title '. Finished bow' with cut-off line 'oiled and' - replace with real finished-bowl hero close-up and fix to '1. Finished bowl'.
3.0-6.0s Raw oak section is dark green card with no wood visible - lay in actual raw blank footage per outline to show wet/heavy starting point.
6.5-9.5s Turning section is blue card with no lathe action and stuttered subtitle 'the the shape' - add real turning cuts and clean audio/caption.
10.0-14.0s Sanding section is brown card with no hands or dust visible and duplicated 'lathe lathe' - add real sanding detail and tighten edit.
15.0-18.0s Oil finish closer is grey card with no application visible - add real oiling wipe to pay off transformation and hold end frame for story close.
